spec.prompt_template:
Ultra-premium cinematic product photograph, WIDE shot with breathing room, NOT a tight macro: a single matte-black USB-C contactless hardware security key FULLY plugged into and seated in the side USB-C port of a dark charcoal-slate laptop on a dark desk. VIEW: {view}. Preserve the EXACT object shown in the first three reference images (the catalogue plates) — do not restyle, recolour, or change its geometry: matte-black glass-fibre-nylon body, ONE brushed-brass disc centred on the face bearing the PRIMIDS brand mark — the angular X glyph shown in the SECOND reference image (four angled arms radiating from a small central square) engraved DARK on the brushed brass, PERFECTLY CENTERED on the disc, as the disc's ONLY marking. ABSOLUTE PROHIBITION: no letters, no characters, no 'P', no monogram, no red dot, no second glyph on or near the disc — the angular X mark ALONE, exactly as drawn in the second reference image. CRITICAL OVERRIDE: the catalogue plates show a three-arc contactless wave on the disc — that wave glyph is RETIRED and must NOT appear; the disc carries ONLY the PRIMIDS X mark. The body face is otherwise COMPLETELY CLEAN, unbroken matte black. CRITICAL OVERRIDE: the catalogue plates show two small debossed marks (a rounded-rectangle outline and a short bar) between the loop and the disc — those marks are RETIRED and must NOT appear; between the keyring loop and the brass disc there is NOTHING but smooth matte black surface. NO debossed marks, NO rounded-rectangle, NO bars, NO lettering anywhere on the body, nickel-steel USB-C connector hidden inside the port, molded oval keyring through-slot. The FOURTH reference image defines ONLY mood and lighting character — do NOT copy its navy body colour, its gold disc position, or its tight crop. Lighting: moody near-black scene #0a0a0b, low-key cinematic; the key accent is BRAND ORANGE #FA582E — a crisp #FA582E rim light tracing the laptop edge and the key's top face, a soft #FA582E radial glow pooling on the desk behind the port, fading to black toward the left of frame. Sharp focus on the key; the laptop falls into gentle depth. ONLY the key, the laptop and the desk exist — no second device, no props, no hands, no cables, no screen glow, no text. The body is a razor-thin 3.35 mm slab, elegant and blade-like. Object geometry must match this spec exactly:

{cad}
